crossRefs.note: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come…
He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.
Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.
therefore this iniquity shall be to you like a breach ready to fall, swelling out in a high wall, whose breaking comes…
For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant…
but they mocked the messengers of God, and despised his words, and scoffed at his prophets, until Yahweh’s wrath arose…
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
and shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies says: “Even so I will break this people and this city, as one breaks a potter’s…

translations.web: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.
translations.bsb: Therefore calamity will come upon him suddenly; in an instant he will be shattered beyond recovery.
translations.kjv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; suddenly shall he be broken without remedy.
translations.asv: Therefore shall his calamity come suddenly; On a sudden shall he be broken, and that without remedy.
